headline: Nifty won the week but *Friday gave some back*
subline: Up 2.48% on the week. Foreign cash poured in while breadth stayed weak.
hero_text: Nifty gained 2.48% on the week. Friday slipped 0.61%, but fear fell as India VIX dropped 6.75% to 15.50.

why.title: Friday pared the weekly gain
why.desc: Nifty closed at 25,144.30 after a 0.61% slide.

why.title: Nasdaq weighed on mood
why.desc: US indices were lower, with the Nasdaq down 1.56%.

why.title: Foreign flows stayed firm
why.desc: FIIs net bought Rs 5,736.55 Cr as DIIs sold Rs 2,253.58 Cr.

why.title: Decliners outran advancers
why.desc: 939 stocks rose against 1,777 that fell across the NSE.

sector_reasons.PSU Bank: Led the week even with a Friday dip
sector_reasons.Bank: Week's lift held despite a Friday slip
sector_reasons.Private Bank: Gave back part of its weekly gain
sector_reasons.IT: Weekly laggard as Friday added losses
sector_reasons.FMCG: HUL's gain kept it flat on the day

bonus_text: India VIX fell 6.75% to 15.50. Fear eased on a red day and sits below the middle of its 20 session range.
movers_note_gainers: Eicher Motors topped the list at 1.34%. HUL, BSE and Asian Paints trailed.
movers_note_losers: Shriram Finance and TMPV both lost over 3.3%. Grasim and Hindalco trailed.
watch_text: Monday 16 November tests the 24,000 put and 26,000 call walls in Nifty open interest. PCR sat at 0.83.
lessons: The week and the day disagreed. A weekly gain survived a red Friday.
Foreign and domestic funds took opposite sides. FIIs added cash while DIIs sold.
IT stood apart. It was the one major sector lower on the week while banks rallied.
Fear fell with the index. A red close came with calmer options.
alert_text: Monday 16 November opens the week. The Nifty weekly expiry falls on Tuesday 17 November.
cta_headline: Week up, Friday down. *Reopen the chart Monday*.
cta_sub: Next bell is Monday 16 November, with Nifty expiry on Tuesday.
next_text: Monday 16 November opens the new week. Nifty max pain sits at 25,100, close to Friday's finish.
caption_a:
Nifty gained 2.48% this week, yet Friday closed red with 1,777 stocks down.

Nifty ended at 25,144.30, down 0.61%. FIIs added Rs 5,736.55 Cr in cash while DIIs sold Rs 2,253.58 Cr.

Watch: Monday 16 November, with Nifty expiry on Tuesday.
